body.name: Generated-center replicated local-polynomial estimator
body.construction:
Split \((Z_j)_{j=1}^{N}\) into \(K_D\) folds.  For fold \(k\), project the complementary-fold donor mean onto \(([0,1]^d)^S\) and denote cohort \(s\)'s block by \(\widetilde z_{sk}\).  For a candidate bandwidth \(h\), put
\[
u_{stk}(h)=\frac{X_{st}-\widetilde z_{sk}}{h},\qquad
w_{stk}(h)=K(u_{stk}(h)),
\]
\[
L_{sk}(h)=\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{n_s}w_{stk}(h),\qquad
G_{sk}(h)=\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{n_s}w_{stk}(h)b_r(u_{stk}(h))b_r(u_{stk}(h))^{\top}.
\]
Let \(c_G>0\) be the fixed procedural shape constant determined by the kernel, polynomial basis, design-density bounds, and interior constant.  On the finite dyadic grid starting at \(h_s\) and ending at \(1\), select the first \(h=h_{sk}\) such that
\[
L_{sk}(h)>0,
\qquad
\lambda_{\min}\!\left\{G_{sk}(h)/L_{sk}(h)\right\}\ge c_G.
\]
If no grid value passes, declare the fit failed.  On a successful fit set \(u_{stk}=u_{stk}(h_{sk})\), \(w_{stk}=w_{stk}(h_{sk})\), and let \(\widehat\gamma_{sk}\) minimize
\[
\sum_{t=1}^{T}\sum_{i=1}^{n_s}w_{stk}
\left[Q_{sti}-b_r(u_{stk})^{\top}\gamma\right]^2.
\]
Define
\[
\widehat m_s=K_D^{-1}\sum_{k=1}^{K_D}e_0^{\top}\widehat\gamma_{sk},
\qquad
\widehat\tau=\sum_{s=1}^{S}\pi_s
\left(\bar B_s^{\mathrm{obs}}-\widehat m_s\right).
\]
On a failed selected fit set its intercept contribution to zero.  Estimate \(\Sigma\) by the spectrally clipped full sample covariance \(\widehat\Sigma\); no clipping is applied to a successful fitted intercept or to \(\widehat\tau\).
